membership_source: Borsa İstanbul review files (historical archive) + live BIST components
method: Point-in-time membership by historical review snapshot; daily equal-weight rebalanced synthetic OHLC, base 1000. XTUMY = BIST All Shares less BIST 100.
membership_cadence: Historical membership archive is quarterly; broad-market IPO entries use first available quote date.

market_breadth.stage_method: Price-only weekly 30-week SMA. The ±1% four-week slope and ±5% price/SMA distance are approximate classification thresholds; volume is not used.
